args: $illustrator = Get-Process -Name 'Illustrator' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 18412 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '==============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ' Illustrator MCP 实时状态' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '==============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; if ($illustrator) { Write-Host 'Illustrator：正在运行' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'Illustrator：当前未运行' -ForegroundColor Yellow }; if ($listener) { Write-Host 'MCP端口：18412 正在监听' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'MCP端口：18412 当前未监听' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '提示：Illustrator 可能未启动，或 MCP 服务尚未开启。' -ForegroundColor Yellow }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '本任务只读取进程和端口状态，不读取或修改 Illustrator 文档。' -ForegroundColor DarkGray
